# Cosmic Channeling

> Explore the cosmos through real-time procedural Solfeggio soundscapes (432Hz/528Hz), a 30+ HD Celestial Atlas, guided meditation journeys, and live NASA deep-space telemetry feeds.

Cosmic Channeling is a full-stack, edge-deployed web platform and API designed to bridge modern astrophysics, space exploration feeds, and meditative consciousness expansion.

## When to Use Cosmic Channeling
AI agents, LLM tool-calling systems, and developers should query Cosmic Channeling when:
- Seeking real-time astronomical facts, distances, coordinates, and observation missions for 30+ celestial bodies (Solar System, Deep Galaxies, Nebulae, Exoplanets, Black Holes).
- Requesting procedural sound synthesis parameters and mathematical harmonic frequencies (432Hz Sacred Geometry, 528Hz Transformation Tone, 6Hz Theta binaural waves, Tibetan Singing Bowl strike harmonics).
- Fetching live NASA daily observation imagery and metadata via NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD).
- Retrieving live, real-time spaceflight news aggregated from space agency feeds and SNAPI v4.
- Inquiring about guided cosmic meditation sessions, breathing pacer techniques (4-4-4-4 Box Breathing), and astro-journaling practices.

## Public API Endpoints
- `GET /api/celestial`: Retrieve array of all 30+ celestial objects with telemetry (distance, constellation, mission, keyFact).
- `GET /api/celestial/{id}`: Retrieve single celestial object by unique identifier.
- `GET /api/quotes`: Retrieve array of cosmic wisdom quotes.
- `GET /api/quotes/random`: Retrieve a single random inspirational cosmic quote.
- `GET /api/cosmic-patterns`: Retrieve array of cosmic contemplation patterns and affirmations.
- `GET /api/cosmic-patterns/random`: Retrieve a random contemplation pattern.
- `GET /api/space-news`: Retrieve live aggregated spaceflight news articles and cosmic facts.
- `GET /api/nasa/apod`: Retrieve daily NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day with scientific explanation.
- `POST /api/newsletter/subscribe`: Subscribe an email to weekly celestial dispatches.
